verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions support scheduled executions (appwrite-docs-9) and notifications can be scheduled (appwrite-docs-27), giving basic recurring-job capability, but there's no evidence of a broader workflow/orchestration engine, retries, chaining, or dependency management for multi-step workflows. missing for 10: documentation on workflow orchestration (multi-step/chained jobs), cron syntax specifics, monitoring/retry logic for scheduled functions, and independent/hands-on confirmation that scheduled executions work reliably.
